name: Heavy Load
keywords: industrial construction yellow stencil caution machinery split-flap
idea: Plant machinery in black and safety yellow: crawling hazard tape, stencil paint, riveted plates and a split-flap board. Everything has weight.
note: Live: tape crawls, split-flap flips on click, stripes sweep into the button on hover.
borrowed: Industrial safety signage and plant floors: black-and-yellow hazard chevrons, spray-stencilled lettering, riveted rating plates, and the clacking split-flap boards of old stations and airports.
mood: Loud, confident, built to last. Suits bold personal brands, infra/ops tooling, product launches, construction-tech. Wrong for calm, wellness or luxury.

type.meta: Display · Big Shoulders Stencil Display 900; outline lines via -webkit-text-stroke

motion: Tape crawl: background-position loop, 1.4–1.6s linear. Size the tile to the stripe diagonal (stripe × 2 × √2) so it loops without a jump.
Split-flap: each cell cycles random glyphs every ~48ms, then settles left to right with a stagger.
Name stamped letter by letter; belts of words move with scroll.
watchouts: Yellow is a fill and a headline colour. Never body text on white.
Thick coloured borders on one side of a card read as a cheap trick. Use gaps over a yellow ground instead.
Moving tape must stop when the user prefers reduced motion.
